observation.robot: joint names, joint position/velocity, root pose and velocities
observation.restriction: No claim of vision-only, hidden-parameter or sandbox-isolated ordinary-agent evaluation

action.execution: joint projection and fixed effort-limited motors; no root/object or attachment writes

reference_pass: Correct cargo fully in goal for >=2 s; every required physical check true; continuous dense trajectory; no runtime error; unchanged source; complete evidence passes offline rejudgment
score_scope: Binary reference pass; process exit code only reports execution error, and does not mean task success. Formal admission is independent and false.

prospective_test.note: Seed 17 exposed M4-06 slip; M4-06 controller was retuned on nominal and seed 17. Revision 3 freezes those changes before seed 29. All outcomes are retained. Seed 29 is one prospective check, not statistical certification.

comparisons.scope: Team and declared formation comparison; one failed controller cannot prove physical infeasibility.

limitations: Same infrastructure, independently extracted directory; not second-person reproduction
Limited perturbation sample, not broad robustness certification
G1 pelvis harness, no hand grasp
No autonomous coupling/uncoupling, loading, tool discovery or learned agent self-modeling
M4 ground-supported towing excludes M2 lifted carrying
